paper_title: Advancing Globular Cluster Constraints on the Axion-Photon Coupling
notes: Stellar cooling bound from R2 parameter (AGB/HB ratio) in globular clusters. Most conservative constraint g_agamma < 0.47e-10 GeV^-1 = 4.7e-11 GeV^-1 using semiconvection scheme. Valid for ALP masses from O(10^-6) to O(1) eV (paper states these bounds apply below a few keV where thermal Primakoff production occurs). Mass-independent flat bound encoded as horizontal line over stated validity range. An improved bound of 3.4e-11 GeV^-1 is a projection based on asteroseismology (predictive mixing) and not adopted as the main result. | selector: text over figure_vision (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 0, 0.85, 2))
